lines: You cut it. Just like that. I've been walking round that since May.
Don't tell me it was easy. Let me have this one.
...It was easy, wasn't it. Right. Fine.
Up to the quarry, down to the port, up to the quarry. That's the whole of it.
Four hundred times on this road, and the thorn on that spur is new.
One season. Straight across the path. Nothing grows like that.
